jobs.title: Marketing Program Manager
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking for a Marketing Program Manager to join our Partner Marketing team and help us execute co-marketing programs, events, and industry marketing with top game developers and technology partners. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships, marketing, and program management, and plays an important part in supporting partner relationships and program delivery across our platform.

Reporting to the Director, Partner Marketing, you'll work cross-functionally to help ensure the successful launch of win-win-win campaigns: good for players, good for partners, and good for our business. You'll help keep timelines, processes, and cross-functional coordination on track across sales, product, brand, creative, and channel teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Co-Marketing Execution

- Support and execute partner co-marketing campaigns across channels including owned social, email, in-product placements, and live events.

- Help maintain marketing "playbooks" and repeatable program templates that support consistency and faster time-to-launch across partners.

- Support GTM planning for partner moments (new product launches, integrations, tentpole game releases), helping prepare materials and recommendations for review.

- Coordinate with partners' marketing counterparts on creative direction, promotional timing, approvals, and campaign deliverables.

Cross-Functional Program Coordination

- Provide day-to-day program support for Commerce partners, helping keep always-on promotions running smoothly.

- Coordinate with Developer Solutions, Advertising, Commerce, PMM, and Channel Marketing teams to track timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities for partner-facing programs.

- Maintain project timelines, flag dependencies and risks, and help facilitate regular syncs with internal stakeholders.

- Maintain intake and request-tracking workflows (e.g., via Salesforce and Asana) so partner marketing requests are logged, prioritized, and actioned consistently.

- Support the development of B2B marketing collateral and presentations in partnership with Product Marketing and Consumer Marketing teams (newsletters, blog posts, case study amplification).

- Help coordinate partner workshops, innovation days, QBR presentations, and industry summits, using established frameworks and templates.

Reporting & Optimization

- Track campaign performance against business KPIs — including revenue supported, daily account linked players (DALP), and Commerce GMV — and help synthesize insights for the team.

- Help maintain a partner marketing roadmap that shows program activity and status for cross-functional visibility.

- Flag recurring friction points (e.g., one-off approval requests, low-priority asks) to help the team improve processes over time.

What you should have

Experience

- 5–6 years of experience in partner marketing, co-marketing, marketing operations, or program/project coordination — ideally in a tech, gaming, or platform company.

- Experience supporting cross-functional marketing programs, from intake through launch and reporting.

- Some experience working directly with external partners or clients in a marketing capacity.

Skills

- Solid project management instincts: comfortable tracking timelines, managing dependencies across multiple stakeholders, and flagging risks.

- Strong written and verbal communicator, able to organize information clearly for review by others.

- Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage an asset tracker or partner approval request end-to-end.

- Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities.

- Good analytical instincts — comfortable pulling data and connecting program activity to business metrics with guidance.

Tools

- Proficiency in project management and workflow tools (e.g., Asana, Salesforce, Notion, Google Workspace, Claude / AI).

- Familiarity with cross-functional marketing operations, including intake and approval workflows.

- Experience with presentation-heavy environments (Google Slides / PowerPoint) — you'll frequently build and review partner-facing materials.

Bonus Points

- Experience in the gaming industry or with game developer partnerships.

- Background in or exposure to developer marketing, platform marketing, or B2B marketing.

- Familiarity with co-marketing in a deal context — where marketing is part of a larger commercial negotiation.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

For this role, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 3 days a week.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $148,000 to $166,500 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

About the Team

Strategy and Operations sits at the center of how we grow across multiple pillars at Discord. We're building the revenue engine for a business that is scaling fast. This team drives important strategic decisions, establishing operational rigor, and laying the foundation for core processes from the ground up, work that directly supports Discord's mission of building community and belonging at scale.

About the Role

This is a build it yourself role: you'll be the dedicated Strategy & Operations hire supporting Discord's ad sales leaders, standing up pipeline and business health metrics, quota setting, bottoms up planning, and revenue forecasting from the ground up rather than stepping into an already established function. You'll also lead strategic zero to one projects: building systems, processes, and tooling that enable our sales org to scale. The scope is intentionally big, we're looking for a hands on, individual contributor builder, not a team builder or people manager, who can operate as a force multiplier, using AI tools, workflows, and automation to scale your output on the highest priority problems. You'll partner directly and independently with sales leadership, present to executives, and influence cross-functional partners.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own revenue forecasting and pipeline management, synthesizing your point of view on revenue growth, risks, and opportunities to leadership on a weekly and monthly cadence

- Instrument and define pipeline and business health metrics on our Salesforce instance, building the analytics infrastructure this function needs from the ground up

- Lead strategic assessments for new opportunities, including new market expansion, sales team scaling, and go to market optimization

- Partner independently with sales leadership on territory design, account segmentation, and coverage models to maximize revenue potential and seller productivity

- Lead the annual and quarterly goal setting process, ensuring quota targets are data driven, equitable, and support the ambitions of the business

- Analyze sales cycle trends, win and loss patterns, and conversion rates to surface actionable insights that improve sales effectiveness

- Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, and workflows across the business to increase efficiency, reduce friction, and increase selling time

What you should have

- 9+ years of hands on, individual contributor experience in strategy and operations or sales operations at a fast growth company or in management consulting, this is a builder role, not a people management role

- Genuine excitement about building a function from ambiguity, not just operating an established one, you've stood up a process or system from scratch before, not only refined an existing one

- Executive presence and strong, independent stakeholder management, you're comfortable presenting to cross-functional partners and C-level executives, defending your recommendations, and influencing leaders to adopt new ways of thinking, without a manager in the room

- A proven track record of developing analysis that yields actionable insights and executive level strategic recommendations from complex data sets, you can define unique metrics that matter, get into the details on data sources, and implement new approaches to capture new signals

- Proven, hands on AI adoption in your day to day work, including agentic workflows, automated analysis, and AI assisted deliverables, you treat AI as core infrastructure and have specific examples of how it's scaled your output

- A no ego, roll up your sleeves mentality and comfort thriving in ambiguous, fast paced environments

- Experience with CRM systems, such as Salesforce, and proficiency in analytics tools

Bonus Points

- Experience working directly with sales leaders and or in media and advertising

- A unicorn background: sales ops, rev ops, or sales finance experience at a well run, well resourced company, followed by a move to a smaller, scrappier environment

- Management consulting background

- Startup experience

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Program Manager, Creator Partnerships
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Creators are people who build audiences across the internet: influential voices whose communities listen to them and want to spend time together. Many of those communities already live on Discord, but our relationship with creators has grown organically. We have an opportunity to listen more closely, serve them more intentionally, and build a relationship that reflects the role they play on our platform.

We’re hiring a Senior Staff Program Manager to build Discord’s approach to creators from the ground up. You’ll begin with a selected group of creators already using Discord, build the fundamentals that serve them well, and develop programs that make their experience on Discord better. Over time, you’ll turn what works into programs that can serve creators at scale and, eventually, give new creators more reasons to choose Discord. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can lead through judgment, relationships, and execution. You’ll report to the Director of Marketing, Player Communications and partner closely with Support, Product, Marketing, Communications, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

What You'll Be Doing

- Build Discord’s creator strategy from the bottom up, starting with direct conversations and a clear understanding of what creators already on Discord need from us.

- Bring together the creator work that exists across Discord today, establish clear ownership, and turn a collection of early efforts into a coherent program.

- Define who we mean by creators and develop an initial approach for selecting and serving a trusted group across games, platforms, formats, and communities.

- Create more than one program for creators, beginning with the fundamentals: accelerated support, clear paths for escalation, and reliable channels for two-way communication.

- Manage relationships with important creators directly. Understand how they use Discord, help them solve meaningful problems, and build trust by following through.

- Build a creator council or network that gives us a consistent view of what creators are seeing, where Discord is falling short, and what would make the platform more useful to them and their communities.

- Build systems and playbooks that let a selected program grow over time without losing the relationships and responsiveness that made it valuable.

What you should have

- A strong passion for Discord and/or gaming, and an appreciation for the creators and communities we serve.

- 7+ years in creator partnerships, community, platform programs, marketing, product partnerships, or a related field.

- Deeply familiar with how creators build audiences, operate their businesses, and manage communities across platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Instagram, Patreon, Reddit, and Discord.

- You have built and operated creator or partner programs at scale, and you understand how to begin with a selected group without designing something that can never grow beyond it.

- Biased to ship and iterate. You can launch a useful first version, learn from it, and raise the ambition over time.

- Comfortable leading as an individual contributor. You create alignment and momentum across teams without relying on headcount or reporting lines.

- An excellent cross-functional partner across Support, Product, Marketing, Comms, Partnerships, Policy, and more.

Bonus Points

- You have built a creator, partner, ambassador, advisory, or VIP program for a consumer platform.

- You have designed accelerated support or escalation programs for influential users.

- You have worked directly with gaming creators and understand the relationship between creators, games, and communities.

- You have built programs involving product access, creator events, recognition, or discovery.

- You have helped turn creator feedback into product changes, policies, or platform strategy.

- You have built a program that began with a small trusted group and expanded without losing what made it valuable.

jobs.title: Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Strategic Finance Analyst to join our growing Revenue Finance team at Discord. Reporting to the Finance Manager for Revenue, you will be responsible for driving revenue modeling, revenue forecasting, preparing regular reporting and analysis, understanding the drivers of our rapidly expanding subscription business, and partnering with cross-functional teams to support functional strategic initiatives and unlock new growth opportunities. In this role, you will work with senior leaders across Data Science, Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Operations to make a direct impact on revenue strategy and decision-making. Come help us pave the way to a more awesome Discord!

What you'll be doing

- Forecast the future. Build and maintain long-range revenue forecasts, incorporating cohort behavior, product impacts, FX trends, and experimentation data.

- Analyze key drivers. Dive into ARPU, retention, platform mix, and geo/product performance to surface actionable insights.

- Automate & optimize. Streamline processes and dashboards in Excel, Pigment, and Looker; replace manual workflows with scalable, documented systems.

- Build with AI. Use AI agents like Claude Code and Codex to draft models, automate reporting, and turn raw data into first-draft analysis, then bring the judgment to know when the output is right.

- Partner for growth. Build strong relationships with Product, Partnerships, Engineering, and GTM teams to size opportunities, vet new initiatives, and set targets.

- Uplevel Data Pipelines & Processes. Collaborate with Accounting and Data Science to resolve data discrepancies, reconcile figures across different data sources, and build real-time reporting and forecasting capabilities.

- Build Robust Processes. Identify ambiguities in data or process, bring structure, and institutionalize best practices that remain robust over time.

- Grow the craft. Bring a hunger to learn, pick up new AI tools as they emerge, and grow through hands-on mentorship as you raise the bar for the team.

What you should have

- 1+ years in investment banking, top-tier consulting, or high-growth tech FP&A with heavy financial-modeling ownership.

- Strong mastery of Excel & modelling techniques, experience with SQL, FP&A tools, and Data visualization tools also encouraged.

- Experience with consumer-subscription modeling: subscription conversions, cohort-level assumptions, churn curves, and FX forecasting.

- Passion for exploring options to automate and optimize workflows to save time and improve accuracy.

- Hands-on fluency with AI agents like Claude Code and Codex, and genuine curiosity about applying them to finance work.

- The ability to distill complex analysis into crisp recommendations for executives and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Growth sits at the front door of Discord's consumer experience. Our mission is to grow Discord's community responsibly — helping new people discover Discord, land and activate quickly, and stay connected to what they care about. This role owns the full arc of a new user's first experience: how they find us through search, how they register and log in, how onboarding introduces what Discord is, and how notifications bring them back to the moments that matter.

As our Senior Design Manager, you'll report to the Director of Product Design and lead a talented team of designers across the full product development cycle, from strategic visioning through launch and iteration. Your team owns the new user's journey — spanning discovery, sign-up, onboarding, notifications, and the earliest days of the Discord experience.

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead and grow a team of product designers working across acquisition, activation, and re-engagement

- Inspire teams through strategic storytelling, leading vision sprints that turn complex problems into compelling product directions with milestoned experimentation proposals

- Balance competing priorities between growth velocity, user value, and product quality, ensuring we build experiences that are effective, high craft, and responsible

- Uphold high design quality standards, and bring moments of delight and joy across the new-user journey, while ensuring our solutions respect user agency and build trust

- Partner closely with cross-functional leaders in product, engineering, and data science to align on strategy and execution

- Champion informed design — through product design, user research, and data — helping your team deeply understand both new and returning users

- Foster a culture of creative excellence, where designers feel empowered to tackle ambiguous problems with empathy and innovation

What you should have

- 10+ years of experience in scaled consumer-facing digital product design work, ideally including growth, onboarding, acquisition, or lifecycle product experiences

- 4+ years directly managing design teams of 4 or more, with a track record of growing talent and building cultures of creative excellence

- Ability to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems or opportunity spaces, and turn insights into compelling product directions

- Experience designing acquisition, activation, or lifecycle experiences, with a strong sense of how early product moments shape long-term retention

- Ability to communicate to peers and executive stakeholders in ways that drive action and uplevel execution

- Strong leadership skills rooted in empathy: you understand how to staff and grow your direct reports in challenging, supportive ways while motivating teams to deliver excellent results

- Comfort operating in ambiguity and navigating tradeoffs between business goals and user value

- A working understanding and curiosity of AI-assisted design workflows - from ideation and prototyping to generative UI - and the design judgment to know when AI output needs a human hand before it ships

Bonus Points

- Personal use of Discord, and/or gaming experience

- Experience with growth experimentation frameworks and data-driven design iteration

- Understanding of how products reach and grow users across surfaces — notifications, search/SEO, onboarding, and shareable/viral loops

- Background in behavioral psychology, habit formation, or user motivation
